name: Modeinspect AI-native design platform landing page by Modeinspect
description: A long-form product landing page alternates a warm off-white canvas with near-black sections, using a luminous lime green as the only strong accent. Oversized sans-serif headlines are paired with occasional distressed or pixel-like display lettering, while the rhythm moves from a spacious hero and product mockup into denser feature grids, proof cards, workflow comparisons, FAQ rows, and a high-contrast closing CTA.
